shared_tail.surface: مصعب بن سعد بن، أبي وقاص

notes: Two taḥwīl branches end at Shu'ba; «قالا» then gives the tail that both share: Hakam, Mus'ab, and Sa'd, the Companion whose words are the saying (rule 3).
Each branch repeats its own names up to Shu'ba, so they are separate groups; the tail is written once.
